    • accountBelongsToUser

      boolean accountBelongsToUser(UUID accountId, UUID userId)
      Checks whether the account belongs to the supplied user.
      Parameters:
      accountId - persistent account identifier
      userId - persistent user identifier
      Returns:
      true only when the ownership relationship exists

    • findAccountTradingProfile

      Parameters:

      trading profile, or empty when the account does not exist

    • findInstrumentTradingProfileBySymbol

      Optional<InstrumentTradingProfile> findInstrumentTradingProfileBySymbol(String symbol)
      Resolves an uppercase symbol, choosing the first match ordered by market code and instrument ID.
      Parameters:
      symbol - instrument trading symbol
      Returns:
      instrument flags, or empty when the symbol is unsupported

    • findByAccountAndClientReference

      Optional<OrderSubmissionResponse> findByAccountAndClientReference(UUID accountId, UUID clientReference)
      Looks up an earlier submission using the account-scoped idempotency key.
      Parameters:
      accountId - persistent account identifier
      clientReference - caller-supplied idempotency key, scoped to the account
      Returns:
      existing order, or empty when the key has not been used

    • insert

      Optional<OrderSubmissionResponse> insert(UUID accountId, UUID instrumentId, String symbol, UUID clientReference, String side, long quantity, String orderType, BigDecimal bufferPercent)
      Inserts a SUBMITTED order without overwriting an existing account/client-reference pair.
      Parameters:
      accountId - persistent account identifier
      instrumentId - persistent instrument identifier
      symbol - instrument trading symbol
      clientReference - caller-supplied idempotency key, scoped to the account
      side - order side, BUY or SELL
      quantity - number of units in the order
      orderType - order type, such as MARKET
      bufferPercent - order-specific execution tolerance percentage, or null to use the account default
      Returns:
      inserted order, or empty when the idempotency key conflicts
